column1: # What ofType() keeps of a FHIR primitive asked for by a System type (plan
# 017). FHIR fhirpath.html (R4/R4B 2.9.1.2, R5 2.1.9.1.2) maps each primitive
# to the System type its value converts to, and R5 says "ofType() does not have
# such restrictions". pat.json, obs.json and media.json hold plain elements;
# ext-NN.json one extension value of each primitive kind; ext-i64.json an R5
# integer64; pat-edge.json Element.id, a primitive with only extensions, and
# spelling variants. Each difference is classified in plan 017.
